status: draft — every outcome needs review by two subject reviewers before publishing
alignment: UNESCO Global Proficiency Framework (reading & mathematics, grades 1–9) — minimum proficiency levels
Cross-checked against Cambridge Primary/Lower Secondary, US Common Core + NGSS, India NCF 2023 (coverage check only; no text copied)

sensitiveTopics.religion: Beliefs, religious practices and festivals. Taught descriptively (what people believe), never as advocacy. Hidden unless a parent unlocks it with their PIN.
sensitiveTopics.body: Puberty, reproduction, relationships and consent education. Hidden unless a parent unlocks it with their PIN.
sensitiveTopics.politics: Government systems, elections, contested history and current issues. Taught with multiple perspectives and sources. Hidden unless a parent unlocks it with their PIN.

bands.name: Little Explorers
bands.ai: read-aloud and simple questions only; no free chat
bands.style: pictures, sound, play, parent beside the child

bands.name: Early Learners
bands.ai: 'Ask why' helper, short safe answers, parent can see every chat
bands.style: concrete, hands-on, short videos (<5 min), praise effort

bands.name: Discoverers
bands.ai: hint-ladder tutor (nudge → bigger hint → similar worked example); never gives homework answers

bands.name: Thinkers
bands.style: debate, abstract ideas, choice of topics, respectful (not babyish) tone

bands.name: Builders
bands.ai: Socratic tutor + study planner; never writes essays or solves assignments
